rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Chunk 1 line 15 'Access mapping, STRIDE, and the ADR all live here' resolves against the enclosing module's `## What You'll Learn` (earn-the-trust.md line 23: 'Invoke curated access-control-analysis and STRIDE skills... write the decision as an ADR') via §1's module-include-order carve-out — verified this exercise is the module's FIRST `## Start here` link (earn-the-trust.md line 33, before 'Map the access surface' at line 37 and 'Threat-model with STRIDE' at line 39), so this draws only on module signposting, never a later sibling exercise. Chunk 3 line 45 'the test-strategy skill' resolves the same way against earn-the-trust.md line 25 ('Author a test-strategy skill through conversation with Claude'). Chunk 4 line 53's 'the test-strategy skill' resolves in-file to chunk 3's own naming. Chunk 4 line 52 'them' (the two windows) resolves against the chunk's own header, 'Set the two windows side by side' (header counts as in-chunk) — checked specifically because the 2026-08-30 lean pass (`git log -p -1`) cut the prior redundant 'Two windows, side by side.' bullet that used to also name it. 'The sibling worktree' (chunk 2 line 33, chunk 3 line 37) resolves back to chunk 1 line 23's definition. No unresolved referent in the current body.

Only cross-file pointer in the body is chunk 1 line 23: 'The [Multi-session and Git survival guide](../trainings/agentic-engineering-101/reference/multi-session-git.md) carries the longer read.' Named by title, not located by page position — matches the §2 navigational-pointer carve-out. No other file named anywhere in the body.

Closest candidate is chunk 2 ('Read back the worktree path', lines 31-33), the file's shortest chunk: 'Claude reports the sibling worktree path. That path is where the second session opens.' Carries one self-standing claim (destination of the next session), not a bare wait-state fragment. The maintainer block also carries a direct dated accept-note on exactly this slide (line 57): 'Carded and kept (Antti 2026-08-25): the Read back the worktree path slide — the explicit read-back beat stays; do not re-card.'

All four `##` headers are literally true of their chunk content: 'Fork the side worktree from your security lane' (chunk 1) opens the m3-security session and forks via the prompt block; 'Read back the worktree path' (chunk 2) is exactly that beat; 'Open the quality lane in the new worktree' (chunk 3) opens the m3-quality session there; 'Set the two windows side by side' (chunk 4) is the arrangement instruction. None contradicted by chunk body.

Checked all five sub-items against every chunk including the lede. `grep -nE 'Not [A-Z][a-z]+\. Not' body.txt` → 0. No anaphora/epistrophe triples anywhere. No self-grading superlative — closest is chunk 0 line 9, 'two Claude Code sessions running side by side on one git history', a plain factual description, not a value claim. No number-with-retraction (only number in body is '~5 minutes' at line 3, never retracted). No abstraction-noun stacks — vocabulary stays concrete throughout (worktree, branch, window, session, skill, path). No verb-triplet construction present to test.

Chunk 4 line 53's 'The move this module installs: when one window kicks off a long-running prompt, the other is where you work' echoes chunk 0 line 11's '**The point:**' — the shape a prior instance of this class (body_sha 4697e007…) flagged as sub-class (c), aphorism kicker. That prior finding is now superseded: `git log -p -1` on this file shows a 2026-08-30 maintainer edit added a dated accept-note directly addressing this exact line (line 59): '"The move this module installs:" lead-in stays (Antti 2026-08-30, family ruling with map-the-access-surface.md L51): theory-spine recall at the moment of use, not self-narration — check_student_facing.md §33 judges should not re-flag either twin.' Rule 16(b)'s own text names itself 'the slides-class face of check_student_facing.md §33', so this accept-note binds here directly, not by analogy. Remaining bullets all earn their slot: worktree definition (line 23), CLAUDE.local.md non-sync (line 24), base-branch choice (line 25), path destination (line 33), skill-crossing mechanism (line 45) each state a fact, decision point, or instruction not said elsewhere.
